reviews.name: Workeer
reviews.note: Address on Impressum page gives Berlin, Germany. Language menu shows Deutsch and Englisch. Preise page describes monthly packages with no minimum term. Prices are quoted from a summarizing fetch and should be checked against the raw page.

reviews.name: Randstad Digital
reviews.note: Language menu shows en, fr, de. About page and home page do not state a founding year. Partnerships page has the heading our partnership ecosystem but does not state a partner program, so partner_program is recorded as unknown.

reviews.name: Comunidad de Madrid Empleo (Objetivo: tu empleo)
reviews.note: Institucion page states Sede del Gobierno de la Comunidad de Madrid but no country is stated verbatim. Datos abiertos page has no API or key text and links to a catalog on datos.comunidad.madrid, which is outside the entry domain and was not used. First fetch of institucion returned HTTP 503; retry succeeded.

reviews.name: 51job
reviews.note: ehire.51job.com is a login page for an enterprise recruitment platform with no text on how employers post jobs or connect feeds. Main site has only a nav link labelled 我要招人 and no posting method text.
